description: Free: up to 3 Indonesian articles matching a keyword — a brand, person, place or issue (e.g. 'rupiah', 'pertamina'). Each with detected entities and an auditable sentiment score. Paid GET /search returns up to 25. Pass lang="en" to search English-language coverage of Indonesia.

lang.description: id = Bahasa Indonesia (default), en = English-language coverage of Indonesia.

q.description: Keyword or phrase; Indonesian works best.
